headline: Onchain Fixed-Rate Loans Emerges as Critical Gap for Real-World Crypto Reserves
summary: Industry analysts point to fixed-rate lending as a missing piece for real-world asset protocols backing stablecoins, noting a 5% shift in reserves could generate $1.8 billion in new demand.
why: Real-world assets (RWA) digitized on blockchain networks represent a rapidly growing bridge between traditional debt markets and decentralized finance.
